A hard-coded string that should probably be a message. On with `extract.autoDetect`.

The check has the severity `info`, but it runs only when the config turns it on.

The check is on when `extract.autoDetect` is `true`, or when you set a severity for it in `checks`. Run `x18n extract` to turn the reported strings into keys.

## Configure

Turn the check on in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from 'x18n'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'hard-string': 'warning',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only hard-string` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip hard-string` skips it for one run.
